# Contributing to PyRomusa AI 🚀

Thanks for your interest in contributing!

## How to contribute

### 1. Clone & Fork/Branch the repo

Download the entire repository to work on, then create your own fork/branch

``` bash
git clone https://github.com/Robertinoos13/PyRomusa-AI-Library.git
```

---

### 2. Think about what type of update you want to make and proced it

Depending on what type of update you want to do, you need to proceed in a certain way.

#### a) Update to a random file _(e.g. `⚙️publish.yml`, `📄README.md`, `🐍benchmark.py` etc.)_

- Here you are allowed to make changes with a Pull Request on the `main` branch wherever needed, after the owner checks it. 

- You have no limits on changes.

- **Pull requests that resolve simple typos or buggy code files and do not directly depend on `PyRomusa AI`'s source code have the best chance of being accepted.**


#### b) Creating a new version of `PyRomusa AI`

- **You can release your own `MODDED` version**

- You are not allowed to directly modify other types of versions (`STABLE` or `EXPERIMENTAL`)

- If you really want to touch directly the versions like `STABLE` or `EXPERIMENTAL`, your pull request will be instantly rejected and you will have to just make your own branch or fork.

- **As a second chance, for your `MODDED` version to have a chance of reaching the `STABLE` or `EXPERIMENTAL` version, you can specify this in the `📄README.md` file of your version, in the example structure available in the `/all versions/MODDED versions/` folder.**

- **Do you want your `MODDED` version to end up as an `OLD` version? This will never happen**, because no one should touch this type of version anymore, so that everyone can see where `PyRomusa AI` started.


#### c) Modifing directly the repo's structure

- Small chance of being accepted via pull request

- In most cases you should stay on your own fork/branch and not change anything in `main` in this regard.

- **BUT if your refactoring is considered better than the current one, then it will be accepted as a pull request on `main`**

---

## Ideas to work on

- better reply engines for `Chatbot()` object _(be sure to make this in a new `MODDED` version created by you)_

- correcting typos from `📄README.md` files

- updating `📄README.md` files

- adding new prepared datasets _(be sure to make this in a new `MODDED` version created by you)_

- fixing existing bugs _(be sure to make this in a new `MODDED` version created by you)_

---

## More

- The prepared datasets and reply engines available in the main `📄README.md` should not be related to the options available only in the `MODDED` versions. These will be added here manually by the owner.
